content: वर्तिः, -र्ती {%f.%} [वृत्-इन् वा डीप् <ls>Uṇ. 4. 130</ls>, <ls n="Uṇ. 4.">135</ls>] .²1 Anything wrapped round, a pad, roll. .²2 An unguent, ointment, eye-salve, collyrium or any cosmetic (in the form of a ball or pill); सा पुनर्मम प्रथमदर्शनात्प्रभृत्यमृतवर्तिरिव चक्षुषोरानन्दमुत्पादयन्ती <ls>Māl. 1</ls>; इयगमृतवर्तिर्नयनयोः <ls>U. 1. 38</ls>; कर्पूरवर्तिरिव लोचनतापहन्त्री <ls>Bv. 3. 16</ls>; <ls>Vb. 1</ls>. .²3 The wick of a lamp; उज्ज्वलालोकया स्निग्धा त्वया त्यक्ता न राजते . मलीमसमुखी वर्तिः प्रदीपशिखया यथा .. <ls>Māl. 10. 4</ls>; a lamp. .²4 The projecting threads or unwoven ends (of a cloth), the fringe. .²5 A magical lamp. .²6 The protuberance round a vessel. .²7 A surgical instrument (such as a bougie). .²8 A streak, line. .²9 Swelling in the throat. .²10 A swelling formed by internal rupture.
